title: Plural negative yes/no questions
summary: Form emmekö, ettekö, and eivätkö questions followed by ole.
objectives: Attach -kö to each plural negative verb.
Keep the plural person contrast clear.
Use ettekö for plural and polite-singular te.

sections.title: Three plural negative question forms
paragraphs: The plural negative verb also takes -kö: emmekö, ettekö, eivätkö.
Use ole after the explicit subject: Eivätkö he ole täällä?

sections.title: Agreement stays visible
paragraphs: The beginning of the question still tells you who the subject is. Match me with emmekö, te with ettekö, and he with eivätkö.
Polite singular te keeps the same ettekö form as plural te.

steps: The form also fits polite singular te.

commonMistakes: Do not confuse emmekö and ettekö.
Do not switch polite te to a singular negative form.
